audit.whatIsWrong: Nevermove is repeatedly labeled '(W)' in wants.you[0] and spikes[0].text, and spikes[1].text describes a 'W-into-E-into-R' all-in. Per enemyKit, Nevermove is Swain's E (root/pull); W is Vision of Empire (a global-range reveal/slow, not a root). whys[1] also calls the level-2 threat a 'single W threat' when the root is E.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/swain.json enemyAbilities: W=Vision of Empire, E=Nevermove. The page's all-in advice pointed readers at the wrong ability slot for the matchup-defining root.
audit.corrected: Relabel Nevermove as (E) everywhere it appears, and fix the combo description to E-into-R (dropping the erroneous W step).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side and phases[5].side both say 'Skill' (Karma) while win[4] and win[5] already say 'Swain' for the same two rows (Level 6, First item) — self-contradicting chart. The full-layer why text for both rows still describes Karma pressing a lead, not Swain's power spike.
audit.why: content whys[4]/whys[5] and spikes[1]/spikes[2] correctly describe Swain's Demonic Ascension leech and Rylai's/soul-stacking item spike beating Karma at these two stages, matching packet.levelChart (Swain at rows 4-5). The full-layer side/why lagged behind.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[4].side and phases[5].side to Swain and rewrite their why lines to match; win[4]/win[5] already correct, no content edit needed.
